aggregation: sum 20 steps, median repeats within a geometry, then median/range across independent geometries; no failed rows discarded

frozen_selection.rule: Fastest accurate no-failure non-baseline classical mechanism on development only; not an AI model selection.

split_audit.note: Reporter checks saved split metadata; it does not regenerate coefficient fields.

ritz_warm4.description: Retrospective cost subtraction on fixed measured trajectories only. Sum each complete repeat first, subtract its component totals, median repeats within geometry, pair with the baseline median, then summarize geometries. Neither an executable zero-cost algorithm, a speedup prediction, nor a universal lower bound.
